Owners.metaTitle: For Villa Owners — Maximize Direct Bookings | StayVilla
Owners.metaDesc: List your Bali villa on StayVilla as an additional channel with lower commission. Receive direct bookings via your own WhatsApp alongside your existing OTA channels.
Owners.heroBadge: Additional Booking Channel for Villa Owners
Owners.heroTitle: Boost Direct Bookings with Substantially Lower Commissions
Owners.heroSubtitle: StayVilla serves as a high-converting supplementary sales channel for Bali villa hosts. Keep listing on Airbnb & Traveloka as usual, while adding a reliable stream of direct guest inquiries straight to your WhatsApp.
Owners.howTitle: How It Works in 4 Easy Steps
Owners.howSubtitle: Simple, transparent, and hassle-free onboarding for discerning property owners
Owners.step1Desc: Submit your villa details in less than 3 minutes using the form below.
Owners.step2Desc: Our team polishes photography, multilingual copywriting, and amenity specifications.
Owners.step3Desc: Your villa is showcased to high-intent domestic and international travelers.
Owners.step4Desc: Guests contact your WhatsApp directly with pre-calculated dates, guest count, and pricing.

Owners.faqSubtitle: Clear answers to common questions from villa hosts and managers
Owners.q1: Do I have to leave Airbnb or Traveloka?
Owners.a1: Not at all. StayVilla is specifically designed as an additional marketing channel to boost overall occupancy alongside your existing OTA listings.
Owners.a2: Guests contact your WhatsApp directly with a verified inquiry. You collect deposits and payments directly into your account following your own villa policies.
Owners.q3: Are there any upfront listing fees?
Owners.a3: Zero upfront fees. Registration, curation, and publishing on StayVilla are completely free.
Owners.q4: How long before my villa is published?
Owners.a4: Once your details are submitted, our curation team reviews and launches your listing within 1-2 business days.
